Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: Which one of the following statements is correct? The velocity of sound :
options: Does not depend upon the nature of media
is maximum in gases and minimum in liquids
is maximum in solids and minimum in liquids
is maximum in solids and minimum in gases
Chemistry 2016-I.answer: is maximum in solids and minimum in gases
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (d)  The Sound propagation is facilitated by the collisions between the particles of medium. The inter- molecular distance in solids is very small whereas in gases it is very high. Therefore the velocity of sound is maximum in solids and minimum in gases.

Chemistry 2016-I.question: A piece of ice, 100 g in mass is kept at 0°C. The amount of heat is requires to melt at 0°C is (take latent heat of melting of ice to be 333.6 j / g) :
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (c)  q = m D Hf Where, m = mass, q = heat energy D Hf = heat of fusion q = (100g) × 333.6 J/g = 33360 J

Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: Which one of the following is an example of chemical change?
options: Burning of paper
Magnetization of soft iron
Dissolution of cane sugar in water
Preparation  of  ice cubes from water Chemistry 26
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (a)  Burning of paper is a chemical change because it is irreversible.

Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: Which one of the following statements is not correct ?
options: Hydrogen is an element
Hydrogen is the lightest element
Hydrogen has no isotopes
Hydrogen and oxygen form an explosive mixture
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (c)  Hydrogen has three naturally occuring isotopes denoted by 1H, 2H and 3H.

Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: Which one of the following statements is not correct ?
options: Atoms of different elements may have same mass numbers
Atoms of an element may have different mass numbers
All the atoms of an element have same number of protons
All the atoms of an element will always have same number of neutrons.
Chemistry 2016-I.answer: All the atoms of an element have same number of protons
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (c)  Atoms of the same element always have the same number of protons (is it had a different number of protons it would be a different element.)

Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: The synthetic rubber has replaced natural rubber for domestic and industrial purposes. Which one of the following is the main reason behind that?
options: Natural rubber is unable to meet the growing demand of different industries
Natural rubber is grown in tropical countries only
Raw material for synthetic rubber is easily available
Nutural rubber is not durable
Chemistry 2016-I.answer: Raw material for synthetic rubber is easily available
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (c)  Natural rubber, coming from latex of Hevea brasiliensis containing traces of impurities like protein, dirt, etc. while synthetic rubber is made by the polymerization of a variety of petroleum-based precursors.

Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: The handle of pressure cookers is made of plastic because it should be made non-conductor of heat. The plastic used there is the first man-made plastic, which is :
options: Polythene
Terylene
Nylon
Bakelite
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (d)  Bakelite was invented by Leo Baekeland in New York in 1907. It is the first man made plastic.

Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: Methyl lsocyanate gas, which was involved in the  disaster in Bhopal in December 1984, was used in the Union Carbide factory for production of :
options: Dyes
Detergents
Explosives
Pesticides
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (d)  Methyl Isocyanate gas (MIC) is used in preparation of pesticides.

Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: Two systems are said to be in thermal equilibrium if and only if :
options: there can be a heat flow between them even if they are at different temperatures
there cannot be a heat flow between them even if they are at different temperatures
there is no heat flow between them
their temperatures are slightly different
Chemistry 2016-I.answer: there is no heat flow between them
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (c)  Two systems are said to be in thermal equilibrium if is no heat transfer takes place as both the systems have same temperature.

Chemistry 2016-I.subject: Chemistry
Chemistry 2016-I.question: German silver is used to make decorative articles, coinage metal, ornaments, The name is given because :
options: it is an alloy of copper and contains silver as one of its components
Germans were the first to use silver
Its appearance is like silver
It is an alloy of silver
Chemistry 2016-I.explanation: (c)  German silver is a mixture of copper, zinc and nickel. It is an alloy metal. It is used to make pots and toys due to hardness toughness and resistance to corrosion.
